title: Price rise: BJP stages protest in Bengaluru; warns of Statewide campaign

ai.summary: The BJP staged a protest in Bengaluru against Congress government price hikes, warning of a statewide campaign if the increases aren't reversed.

facts.claim: The BJP staged a protest at Freedom Park of Bengaluru on Wednesday against hike in prices of various commodities and services by the Congress government
facts.quote: The Bharatiya Janata Party which staged a protest at Freedom Park of Bengaluru on Wednesday against hike in prices of various commodities and services by the Congress government

facts.claim: The BJP declared it would launch a statewide campaign against the government if the price hike was not rolled back
facts.quote: declared that it would launch a Statewide campaign against the government if the price hike was not rolled back

facts.claim: BJP State president B.Y. Vijayendra described the milk price increase as the 'Deepavali gift' by the Congress government
facts.quote: Describing the increase in milk prices as the “Deepavali gift” by the Congress government

facts.claim: BJP State president B.Y. Vijayendra referred to the price-raise as the 'sixth guarantee' of the Congress government
facts.quote: Describing the price-raise as the “sixth guarantee” of the Congress government

facts.claim: The BJP State president warned Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar that people were anguished over constant price increases
facts.quote: he cautioned Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar that people were anguished over such a constant increase in prices

ai.background_note: The BJP is warning of a statewide campaign against the Congress government over price hikes following a protest in Bengaluru.
